categories.title: Probabilistic logic programs
losses: Where others win: pgmpy answers grid25, a path query across a 25 by 25 grid of probabilistic edges, in 144 s on the program's ground network, and tddlog runs out of time.

categories.title: Probabilistic database queries
losses: Where others win: ProvSQL is fast on the easy TPC-H queries, its own benchmarks, and faster than tddlog on 107 of them.

categories.title: Markov networks
losses: Where others win: 15 partition functions of the UAI 2022 final set, 14 of them protein networks, run out of time or memory. TensorInference.jl answers each in 45 to 85 s.

categories.title: Probabilistic functional programs
losses: Where others win: PRISM and Storm answer Geni's three largest router networks, which tddlog does not, by value iteration over decision diagrams in double precision; their exact engines time out from 18 to 20 routers.

categories.title: Bit-blasted programs
losses: Where others win: Alea.jl on 65 circuits, six of which tddlog does not answer, and Roulette on 34; Ace, pyAgrum and pgmpy on two clinical trial circuits that tddlog does not answer, and Merlin on one of them; Genfer on the population models, which it answers in milliseconds; Psi on two linear regressions it solves symbolically.
